capabilities: file-storage-and-sharing | Stores uploaded files and folders in a web interface, previews common formats, and shares files or folders by link with optional password and expiry.
description:
UnitySVC runs the official Cloudreve image (the Community edition, version 4) in a separate container for each enrollment, with its own HTTPS address. Cloudreve is a self-hosted file management and sharing system: upload files and folders in the web interface, preview them, share them by link with an optional password and expiry, and add users. This recipe stores files on the instance's own local disk with SQLite for the database; it does not use PostgreSQL or Redis. The database and the uploaded files are kept in the `cloudreve` folder of your home, so they survive stopping the instance and even removing it and enrolling again.

Enroll in the base channel; it asks for no settings. Open the instance address and register an account straight away: the first account registered on a new instance becomes its administrator, so anyone who reaches the address before you could take that role. Then set the site URL and turn off registration in the admin settings. You can run one Cloudreve instance at a time. The `nano` size is small, and all files live on the instance's 1 GiB temporary disk, so this service suits a small private file store, not a large archive. See How to use this service for full setup and limitations.

You pay the selected channel's platform compute cost while the instance runs, including idle time, and the platform keeps the data in your home while it is stopped. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. See the upstream Cloudreve documentation and issue tracker for software-specific help.

features: Upload files and folders, with resumable chunked upload
Share files and folders by link, with optional password and expiry
Previews of common file types and a recycle bin
Multiple users and groups, with the first account as administrator
Your data is kept in your home, across stops, restarts and re-enrollment
